properties.displayName: UAV S16 - AOI Excursion (Unauthorized Area of Interest Departure)
properties.description: UAV가 AOI_Boundary_List 구역을 이탈하고 최소속도 이상 비행 중 탐지. 실제 컬럼: Groundspeed_ms(Groundspeed 아님), MissionId 없음(UAVId 기반). AOI는 MinLat/MaxLat/MinLon/MaxLon 방식으로 판정. MITRE: T0835 (Collection — ICS description 참조)
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 15m;
let minSpeed = toscalar(
    _GetWatchlist('UAV_Threshold_List')
    | where ThresholdKey == 'MinGroundspeed_ms'
    | project toreal(Value));
let AoiBounds = _GetWatchlist('AOI_Boundary_List')
    | project MinLat=toreal(MinLat), MaxLat=toreal(MaxLat),
              MinLon=toreal(MinLon), MaxLon=toreal(MaxLon), MissionId;
UAVTelemetry_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where MsgType == 'GLOBAL_POSITION_INT'
| where Groundspeed_ms > minSpeed
| where isnotnull(Lat) and isnotnull(Lon)
| join kind=leftanti (
    AoiBounds
    | where isnotnull(MinLat)
) on $left.Lat >= $right.MinLat and $left.Lat <= $right.MaxLat
    and $left.Lon >= $right.MinLon and $left.Lon <= $right.MaxLon
| summarize ExcursionCount=count(), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated),
    AvgLat=avg(Lat), AvgLon=avg(Lon)
    by UAVId, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where ExcursionCount >= 3
| extend TriggerReason = strcat("AOI_이탈_", tostring(ExcursionCount), "회_UAVId:", UAVId)
| extend Severity = "Medium"
| project FirstSeen, UAVId, ExcursionCount, AvgLat, AvgLon, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by FirstSeen desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S16 - AOI Excursion (Unauthorized Area of Interest Departure) - {{UAVId}}
